Featured application

A rare shoe should arrive with a story you can check.

From origin registration to delivery, the Rare Shoes experience helps collectors identify the pair, follow each handover, and understand the final physical result.

1

At the beginning

Meet the pair

Record visible details, condition, origin material and physical dynamic tag while it is with the verified authenticator.

→
2

On the way

Follow the handover

Keep every approved custodian, scan and observed physical state connected to the exact same immutable journey.

→
3

At the end

Check what arrived

Compare delivery observations with the origin registration and surface a clear match, review or hold outcome in plain language.

At every step, the collector sees what happened, what was checked, and whether the pair is ready to continue or needs human attention.
